description: Interpret research and data: insights and foresight, each conclusion with its evidence, rivals and a challenge.

plugins.name: poiesis-insight
plugins.description: Insights (connections, contradictions, counted patterns) and foresight (signals, horizons, scenarios, scored forecasts) from a project's research or data. Every conclusion carries its evidence, rivals and what would prove it wrong, and passes a challenge. Agents: insight-analyst, foresight-analyst, challenger.
